typography.weights: Medium (500) for standard, Bold (700) for headers
typography.rules: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings. Monospace MUST be used for all financial data, metrics, and timestamps. Text Size Hierarchy: H1 max text-4xl sm:text-5xl. Use tabular-nums utility in Tailwind.

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000. Separate panels with background steps, not shadows. Saturated colors are STRICTLY reserved for financial statuses (profit/loss, live/stopped). Use 1px thin low-opacity dividers (border-white/10) instead of zebra stripes in tables.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Exposed skeleton, border-collapse style layout. Dashboard cards use flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border, no shadow.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the body background to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.badges: Use sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm max) for status badges (DRAFT, APPROVED, LIVE).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-dense areas. Use solid, opaque colors (#0B0E14) for fixed headers and sidebars to prevent data refraction.

components.table: Dense structure. 1px border-b border-white/5 for rows. Header row with uppercase text-xs tracking-wider text-secondary. Right-align all numeric columns.
components.sidebar: Darkest background (#0B0E14), 1px right border (border-white/10). Active link has left 2px solid brand_primary border, no background fill.
components.cards: Cardless or sharp rectangular styles. Dense internal spacing (p-4 or p-6).
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm), crisp interaction. Hover state must explicitly lighten background.
components.timeline: Decision Timeline: Minimalist vertical line. Nodes colored by agent decision (Green=Agree, Red=Veto). No hidden chain of thought, just summary codes.
components.charts: Shadcn Charts / Recharts. Equity curve must use gradient fill under the line to show volume/area. Tooltips must have opaque backgrounds.
components.alerts: Emergency Stop must be a highly visible button (Red) in the top nav.

grids_and_layouts.general: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 or lg:grid-cols-6. Tight gaps (gap-4).
grids_and_layouts.agent_control_center: Table view taking col-span-full. Clicking an agent opens a side drawer or right-side panel for detailed drilldown (Status, Score, Decision, Reason, Confidence) without leaving the context.
grids_and_layouts.strategy_lab: Bento grid for Strategy creation. Split view: Left parameters, Right backtest preview.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tight padding for data cells (p-2 to p-4), clear separation between major sections.

motion.interactions: Hover states must be instantaneous for data fields. Micro-interactions on buttons (scale down slightly on active).
motion.live_data: Use a blinking dot (animate-pulse) for 'LIVE' connections (MT5) or 'Running Agents'.
motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties (transition-colors duration-150). Do NOT use transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text vs background meets minimum 4.5:1. Red/Green colors must be tuned for dark mode visibility.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, rows, and agent details MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='agent-veto-button', data-testid='emergency-stop').
accessibility.disclaimer: CRITICAL: The website MUST clearly state 'AI does not guarantee profit' in a visible footer or banner.

media_and_icons.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for a sharp, technical look.
media_and_icons.empty_states: Minimalist icon + subtle secondary text. No large illustrations.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not necessary for a pure trading terminal. Use lightweight 2D data visualizations (Recharts) to maintain extreme performance and density.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold by applying 'The Technical Look': sharp edges, monospaced numerals, and exposed grid borders.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Left-align data tables and text, strictly right-align financial numbers.
Create depth using background color steps (e.g., #0B0E14 to #131722), not drop shadows.
Never use AI assistant emojis (🤖🧠). Use clean lucide-react icons.
Use JetBrains Mono or similar monospaced font for ALL numeric data (prices, win rates, expectancies, timestamps, agent scores).
All interactive elements must include data-testid.
Trading implies high risk: ensure the UI feels serious, rigorous, and explicitly displays the required disclaimer: 'AI does not guarantee profit.'
instructions_to_main_agent: Install standard dependencies: lucide-react, recharts (for equity curve/analytics), and clsx/tailwind-merge for utility classes.
Set up Tailwind config with custom colors: background-base (#0B0E14), background-panel (#131722), profit, loss, warning, info.
Build a persistent Sidebar Navigation and a Topbar. The Topbar must contain the Paper/Demo/Live mode toggle and the Emergency Stop + Close All Positions controls.

Implement the Agent Control Center with a dense data table. Include the 10 specific agents: Market Scanner, Market Structure Analyst, Technical Analyst, Price Action Agent, Strategy Builder, Risk/Reward Optimizer, Strategy Critic, Market Regime Agent, Historical Validation Agent, Final Decision Agent.
Implement the Decision Timeline showing timestamped agent execution flow (consensus voting + veto).
Ensure the Strategy Lab displays status badges correctly (DRAFT, BACKTESTING, VALIDATING, APPROVED, LIVE, PAUSED, REJECTED).
Ensure all components are customized for a dense, dark-mode, border-heavy 'terminal' look with minimal border-radius.
